On the first reply,
A guest's enquiry is a doorway. Answer within the hour. In the room you'd use to sit at the threshold itself.
On the small ask,
A bottle of Bandol, a later check-in, a yellow flower that has lost. There is an invitation to trust, not a request to manage.
On the silence afterwards,
Not every message wants a reply. A read receipt and a lantern at twilight will speak for themselves.
